title: Viva Engage: collapse and resize the left navigation, and favourite and reorder more communities
summary: The briefing accurately reports the user-initiated navigation changes and the revised rollout window, with no administrator deadline. It preserves the conflicting published favourites limits and correctly distinguishes the product's licensing requirements from unpublished navigation-specific licensing.
